questions.question: Describe how to bend a 3 mm acrylic sheet to create a 90-degree stand using a line bender.

points.text: 1) Mark the bend line on the protective film. 2) Place acrylic over the line bender's heating element with the bend line directly above it. 3) Heat for 2-3 minutes until flexible. 4) Bend to 90 degrees against a former or jig. 5) Hold until the plastic cools and hardens (do not quench in water - causes stress cracking). 6) Remove protective film.

questions.question: Explain the difference between soldering and brazing, and when each would be used.

points.text: Soldering: joins metals using a filler alloy melting below 450 degrees C. Used for electrical connections, circuit boards, plumbing - low strength, low temperature. Brazing: joins metals using a filler (brass alloy) melting above 450 degrees C (typically 700-900 degrees C). Used for structural joints in bicycle frames, furniture - much stronger than soldering.

questions.question: State four workshop safety rules when using a pillar drill.

points.text: 1) Always clamp the workpiece in a vice - never hold by hand. 2) Wear safety goggles - swarf can fly from the drill bit. 3) Use the correct drill speed - slow for large bits in metal, faster for small bits in wood. 4) Ease pressure on the drill as the bit breaks through the underside.
